title: PrimitiveResult
description: Result returned by Person 3 (Motion Primitive) after executing an ActionPlan. FSM uses this to decide next state: verify / retry / fail.

plan_id.description: Must match the plan_id from the ActionPlan that was executed

object_id.description: Must match the object_id from the ActionPlan

status.description: Outcome of the motion primitive execution. FSM trigger mapping: SUCCESS→VERIFY, GRASP_FAIL→RETRY, DROP→RETRY, WRONG_BIN→FAIL, COLLISION→FAIL, TIMEOUT→RETRY

failure_reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not SUCCESS. Null on success.

actual_bin.description: Filled only when status is WRONG_BIN. Records where object actually landed.
